title: Heavy-job slots scale with the ready machines, and the Workers page and master status show the budget and each machine's load
description: With no limit file the heavy-job budget is floor(cores / 6) for this machine and every ready compute host, at least two: a 24-core machine with ready hosts of 24 and 32 cores admits 4 local jobs and 9 host-placed shards at once, and 4 with the hosts away. A worker verification's slot is freed within one loop cycle once its request finished or its lease is gone, and kept while a child or an active request runs. Master status and the Workers page show '13 heavy-job slots (this machine 4, vish-msi 4, omarchypc 5)' and each machine's cores busy of total and temperature in one short line, with no SSH targets, at 1280 px and 390 px.
